# ACOS Workflow Projection Point

This directory is an ACOS-managed dynamic workflow projection point for **claude**.

Claude Code dynamic workflows (v2.1.154+) are complex JavaScript files that ACOS does not generate automatically.
This directory is created and tracked by the sync engine as a managed projection point.

- User-authored `*.js` workflow files are preserved by the sync engine.
- Run `npx --no-install acos --fix` to regenerate the ACOS-managed README.
